item.title: Meyers, Winterton sign two-year extensions with Kraken
item.description: The Seattle Kraken signed forwards Ben Meyers and Ryan Winterton to two-year contract extensions. Meyers was a pending unrestricted free agent at the end of the season. The deal is a two-year deal with a $1 million AAV.Winterton was a pending restricted free agent without arbitration rights. The deal is a two-year deal with $1.125 AAV. For more Coachella Valley News visit NBCPalmSprings.com

item.title: Second Chance: Big Bear Bald Eagles lay first egg of new clutch
item.description: In a hopeful turn for wildlife watchers, Jackie the bald eagle has laid a new egg after heartbreak earlier this season.The female eagle, known as Jackie from the popular live nest camera operated by the nonprofit organization Friends of Big Bear Valley, produced the first egg of her second clutch this year. item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel is facing renewed criticism following his trip to Italy during the Winter Olympics, where viral images showed him celebrating with the U.S. men’s hockey team after their gold medal win.The trip, which included travel aboard an FBI Gulfstream jet, sparked backlash from lawmakers and raised questions about the use of government aircraft for what critics described as personal travel.
